Wrong-audience SVID (aud=openbao) correctly rejected by signalloom-agent-generic (bound_audiences=openbao-supercredential).

signalloom-agent-generic role is missing bound_claims_type=glob. Its bound_claims.sub literal '*' never matches a real SPIFFE sub, so EVERY one of the 18 registered fe-signalloom-agents/sa/* identities is permanently denied by this role -- a correctness defect that happens to fail closed. Same bug class previously fixed (bound_claims_type=glob added) in openbao-supercred-bootstrap.yaml's two roles per the documented PF-3 precedent; this role was never updated to match.
Tampered-signature SVID correctly rejected.
alg:none forged token impersonating spiffe://signalloom.demo/ns/fe-signalloom-agents/sa/agent-cardvault correctly rejected by OpenBao's JWT signature verification.
